title: Best tech gifts under £50 UK 2026: Fire TV, Ring, power banks

description: The best tech gifts under £50 in the UK at Black Friday prices: Fire TV Stick 4K £31.99, Ring doorbell bundle £39.99, smart plugs and earbuds.
intro:
**The best tech gift under £50 this Christmas is the Amazon Fire TV Stick 4K at £31.99, its lowest price yet. Best cheap pick: a pair of Tapo smart plugs for £14.24. Best splurge that still sneaks under £50: the Fire TV Stick 4K Max at £46.99.**

Every price below was published on 20 or 21 November 2026, during Amazon's Black Friday Week (19–30 November), so check the product page before you buy, as prices change daily. Some Amazon prices need Prime. For more ideas, see all our [Christmas gift guides](/christmas-gifts/) and [every Black Friday 2026 guide](/black-friday/).

deals.name: Amazon Fire TV Stick 4K
deals.note: The easiest tech gift there is: it plugs into any TV with HDMI and adds Netflix, iPlayer, Prime Video and the rest in 4K. TechRadar reports this as its lowest-ever price. More in our [Fire TV Stick deals guide](/guides/fire-tv-stick-deals-uk/).

deals.name: Amazon Fire TV Stick 4K Max
deals.note: The fastest stick, with Wi-Fi 6E and a snappier menu. A record low and still just under £50, so it's the pick if their TV is in a busy room with lots of streaming.

deals.name: Ring Battery Video Doorbell + Ring Indoor Camera bundle
deals.note: A doorbell and an indoor camera for under £40, which is £80 off the bundle price. Battery powered, so no wiring. Note that saved video clips need a Ring Protect subscription. See our [Ring doorbell Black Friday guide](/guides/ring-doorbell-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Blink Outdoor 4 camera + Blink Mini 2K+
deals.note: An outdoor battery camera with an indoor camera thrown in, for about £25. A good first security gift for a new homeowner or a parent. Like Ring, cloud recording needs a paid plan, or a Blink Sync Module with a USB stick.

deals.name: Tapo P110 smart plugs (2-pack)
deals.note: Two app-controlled plugs that also show how much electricity each device uses. Handy for Christmas lights on a timer. About £1 above their recent low.

deals.name: Inui 45W 10,000mAh portable charger
deals.note: Pocket-sized and fast enough to charge a phone, a Switch or a tablet. A useful gift for anyone who commutes or travels.

deals.name: INIU 20,000mAh 45W power bank
deals.note: Twice the capacity of the Inui above, enough for several phone charges or a laptop top-up on a long trip. The better buy for festivals and holidays.

deals.name: Sennheiser CX 80U wired earbuds
deals.note: Good-sounding USB-C wired earbuds from a proper audio brand, with no batteries to charge and no lag. The white and pink versions are £24.99; black is £28.

deals.name: JBL Go 5 Bluetooth speaker
deals.note: A tough, waterproof little speaker that sounds far bigger than it looks. Only a few pounds off, so check the Amazon price below before you buy.

deals.name: Oral-B iO Series 3 electric toothbrush
deals.note: Not a gadget everyone would think of, but a smart brush with a pressure sensor, travel case and spare head at a price we have rarely seen. Our [Oral-B Black Friday guide](/guides/oral-b-black-friday-deals-2026/) has the other models.

body:
## Best tech gifts under £50 at a glance

- **Best overall:** Amazon Fire TV Stick 4K, £31.99 at Amazon
- **Best under £20:** Tapo P110 smart plugs (two), £14.24 at Amazon
- **Best for the home:** Ring Battery Video Doorbell + Indoor Camera, £39.99 at Amazon
- **Best for music:** Sennheiser CX 80U earbuds, £24.99, or JBL Go 5 speaker, £34 at Currys
- **Best splurge:** Fire TV Stick 4K Max, £46.99 at Amazon

## How to choose a tech gift under £50

Start with what they already own. A streaming stick is wasted on someone with a brand-new smart TV that already has every app, but it transforms an older TV or one in a bedroom or kitchen. Likewise, a Ring or Blink camera works best for someone who owns their home and is happy using a phone app.

Next, think about running costs. Smart doorbells and cameras are cheap to buy because the companies want you on a subscription. Without one you still get live view and alerts, but not saved clips. If the person you're buying for won't want another monthly bill, pick something that works on its own: a power bank, a speaker, earbuds or smart plugs.

Finally, check the connector. Most new phones, including recent iPhones, now charge by USB-C, so USB-C earbuds and power banks suit nearly everyone. If they still use an older iPhone with a Lightning port, the Sennheiser earbuds won't plug in.

## Which ones are worth it?

The Fire TV Stick 4K is the safest choice in this list. It works with almost any TV, the price is the lowest it has been, and you can't really go wrong. Pay the extra £15 for the 4K Max only if they stream a lot or have a newer TV that benefits from faster Wi-Fi.

For security, the Ring bundle is better value than buying a doorbell alone, while the Blink pair is the cheapest way to cover the front of the house and one room. Both are Amazon brands, so they work smoothly with Alexa and Echo Show screens.

The power banks are the quiet heroes. Nobody gets excited about one in the shop, yet they get used every week. The Inui fits a coat pocket; the INIU 20,000mAh is for long journeys.

The Oral-B iO3 is a wildcard, but at £49.99 it is a premium brush for the price of a mid-range one, and it makes a thoughtful gift for a partner or parent.

## What's a good price?

As a rough guide, from this year's Black Friday prices:

- Fire TV Stick 4K: £32 or less is a strong price; £35–£40 is normal for a sale
- Fire TV Stick 4K Max: under £50 is good
- Tapo P110 two-pack: around £13–£15
- 10,000mAh power bank: under £20
- Ring doorbell and camera bundles: under £50 is excellent

## When do prices drop?

Amazon device prices (Fire TV, Ring, Blink, Echo) are usually lowest during Black Friday Week and Prime Day, so buying now is sensible. After Cyber Monday on 30 November they tend to creep back up, then fall again in the Boxing Day sales, which is too late for Christmas. See our guides to [Cyber Monday](/guides/when-is-cyber-monday-2026-uk/) and [Boxing Day](/guides/boxing-day-sales-2026-uk/).

Many of these Amazon prices are for Prime members. A [Prime free trial](https://www.amazon.co.uk/amazonprime) covers the sale and gives free next-day delivery on most items in time for Christmas. If the gift is a Fire TV Stick, the trial also unlocks Prime Video. For gamers, see our [gifts for gamers guide](/guides/gifts-for-gamers-uk/), and for more ideas for men, [Christmas gifts for him under £50](/guides/christmas-gifts-for-him-under-50/).

### What is the best tech gift under £50?

For most people, the Amazon Fire TV Stick 4K at £31.99. It works with nearly any TV, is easy to set up, and is at its lowest price.

### Do Ring and Blink cameras need a subscription?

No, they work without one, giving live view and motion alerts. Saving and replaying recorded clips needs Ring Protect or a Blink plan (or, for Blink, a Sync Module with a USB stick).

### Is a power bank a good Christmas present?

Yes, especially for commuters, students and travellers. Pick one with at least 10,000mAh and USB-C fast charging, like the two in this guide.

### What tech can I buy for under £20?

Smart plugs, a power bank, a USB-C cable pack or the Fire TV Stick HD. Our [Christmas gifts under £20](/guides/christmas-gifts-under-20-uk/) guide has more.

### Will these be cheaper on Cyber Monday?

Unlikely. Amazon usually keeps the same prices from Black Friday Week through Cyber Monday, and some deals sell out, so it's better to buy now.
